ngaap.guidance: 2022 guidance maintained but shifted to the LOW END of each range (28-Jul-2022): Revenue $17.3B - $17.7B (low end); organic revenue growth up 1.0% - 3.0% (low end; 2H22 growth mid-single-digit); net income margin 12.00% - 12.25%; segment operating margin 16.00% - 16.25%; GAAP EPS $10.75 - $11.05; non-GAAP EPS $13.35 - $13.65; operating cash flow $2.4B - $2.5B (reconciliation table prints '$2,405 - $2,375' for the low-end guidance versus previous $2,405 - $2,505); adjusted free cash flow $2.15B - $2.25B (low end $2,150M; reflects $600M - $700M R&D capitalization impact). By segment: IMS $7.1B - $7.3B, up 2.0% - 4.0% (low end), margin 13.50% - 13.75% (low end); SAS $6.0B - $6.1B, flat - up 2.0% (low end), margin 12.50% - 12.75% (low end); CS $4.3B - $4.4B, flat - up 2.0% (vs. $4.4B - $4.5B, up 2.0% - 4.0%), margin 24.25% - 24.50% (high end). Other: net FAS/CAS pension adjustment ~$540M (service cost ~(45), CAS ~(145), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~100, non-service FAS pension income 440); net interest expense ~$265M; integration expenses ~$75M (vs. ~$35M); non-GAAP effective tax rate ~15%; average diluted shares ~193M (vs. ~194M); capex ~$300M (vs. ~$330M); cash used for merger integration ~75. Low-end reconciliation: revenue $17.3B; segment operating income $2,770M; unallocated corporate ~(15); merger integration ~(75); amortization ~(605); FAS/CAS pension adjustment, net ~540; net interest ~(265); income taxes ~(275); net income $2,075M (12.00%); GAAP EPS $10.75 + integration ~0.39 + amortization ~3.13 - NCI ~(0.02) = pre-tax ~3.50, taxes ~(0.90), after-tax ~2.60 -> non-GAAP EPS $13.35.
ngaap.notes: Segment operating income / margin (non-GAAP in total): sum of segment operating income, excluding unallocated items (unallocated corporate department expense, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, divestiture / impairment items, other items) and the FAS/CAS operating adjustment; from fiscal 2022 segments are charged CAS pension cost and the former 'pension adjustment' (which included non-service FAS pension income) is replaced by the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, with non-service FAS pension income in non-operating income (comparatives recast). Non-GAAP EPS: EPS from continuing operations excluding amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, divestiture-related gains/losses and expenses, impairments and other items, net of tax and the NCI portion; FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income are NOT excluded (remain in non-GAAP EPS). Adjusted free cash flow: net cash provided by operating activities less net additions of property, plant and equipment, plus cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs (and net cash paid for income taxes associated with business divestitures, where applicable). Non-GAAP effective tax rate: tax rate on non-GAAP pre-tax income. The FCF bridge in the release is for the quarter (three months); cf in this file is year to date. From Q2-22 the reconciliation prints an adjusted 'Operating Income' (688, 16.6% of revenue) and GAAP EBIT (592, incl. non-operating income); recorded here as adj_ebit (it excludes non-operating income). Q2-22 adjustments: merger integration 26, amortization 151, gain on sale of asset group (8), other divestiture-related expenses 35; taxes (47). Free cash flow subtotal not printed this quarter. Net debt / adjusted EBITDA 1.9x; adjusted EBITDA (quarter) 879.
